title: Newsletters — Sub-program newsletters
slide_intent: Show how a local community can name its newsletter while readers can still see which accredited program endorses it.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can give local publications an identifiable voice while keeping the parent program’s mark consistent.
demonstration: FanMail and News use similar nonbleed mastheads, columns and contacts. Community names appear with the titles while accredited program names remain in the marks.
practical_value: Put the sub-program or community name in the newsletter masthead and its contact details in the footer. Use the accredited program lockup for endorsement.

content_islands.name: Local attribution guidance
content_islands.spec: Use the left column for the distinction between the local publication name and the accredited program mark.

content_islands.name: Paired desktop newsletters
content_islands.spec: Place the color and grayscale examples side by side. Align mastheads and program marks at the top, then show the column structure, subheads, pull quotes and local contact footers.
